lines.text: Here is the list of prices for the new menu. Can you check it this week?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: When do you need it by? I can start on Thursday morning.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I need the first page by noon on Friday. The rest can wait until Monday.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I can give you the first page on Thursday afternoon. Is four okay?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Four is fine. Could you finish the rest by Monday at ten?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes. Do you need the paper copy, or can I send a photo?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: A photo is fine for Thursday. Please bring the whole list on Monday.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Okay, a photo on Thursday at four and the full list by ten on Monday.
lines.speaker: Eli
